questions.stem: Approximately what percentage of the total mass of the solar system does the Sun account for?
questions.explanation: The Sun accounts for approximately 99.8% of the total mass of the solar system. Its enormous mass is what holds all the planets, moons, asteroids, and comets in orbit around it.

questions.stem: What is 1 astronomical unit (AU) defined as?

options.text: The distance from the Earth to the Moon
The average distance from the Earth to the Sun, approximately 1.5 × 10¹¹ m
The diameter of the solar system
The distance light travels in one year

questions.explanation: One astronomical unit (AU) is defined as the average distance from the Earth to the Sun, approximately 1.5 × 10¹¹ metres. It is commonly used to measure distances within the solar system.
